title: We build your home on your land
intro: Design, permits, materials and construction. You see every update in photos and pay for each stage when you see it finished.
cta: Get a quote for my home
calculatorLink: How long will it take with what I send each month?

design.title: Design and permits
design.body: We choose a model with you or design one to measure, and get the building permit.

stages.title: Construction in stages
stages.body: Foundation, walls, roof, utilities and finishes. Every week we send you photos and videos.

payments.title: You pay for what you see
payments.body: Each payment is made when you see the previous stage finished. You never prepay the whole build.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: We walk through the house with you or your relative and hand over the keys.

modelsIntro: Proven designs that can be adjusted. The price changes with the finish and the department.
customTitle: Do you have your own design?
customBody: We also build custom designs. Get a quote by square meter and we'll draw it with you.
customCta: Get a quote for a custom design

model.quoteCta: Get a quote for this model
model.pricesIntro: Estimated price in {department}. In other departments it changes a little because of freight and labor.
model.pricesNote: House only. Land and extras are added in the quote tool.
